variants.name: RopeRailing
variants.collider: 2 boxes for the posts + 1 thin box (or capsule) along the rope at 0.55-0.8 m; rope collider blocks walking off the edge
variants.joins: posts at x = +/-1.3 from the centre; neighbouring sections overlap one post or leave ~0.1 m; corners by rotating a section
variants.notes: Posts with carved notches (real recesses), 5 rope wraps, sagging rope, knot (2 loops) and tails are geometry; rope uses Props `rope`, post tops end_grain.
